about: Daily exam news for the start-page pill and the 'Latest exam news' list on /exam-notifications.html. Not site updates. Refreshed every morning (scheduled task, Anil 17 Nov 2026). Newest first is not required; the build sorts by date. Fields: date (YYYY-MM-DD the news came out), tag (Notification, Admit card, Exam date, Result, Answer key, Last date, Correction window, Notice), short (pill text, under about 80 characters), text (one or two sentences for the list), url (the board's own website), via (news source used, if not the board's site), exam (site exam id, optional, for a Practise link).

items.short: SBI Clerk 2026: prelims result declared; mains call letters out
items.text: State Bank of India has declared the result of the Junior Associate (Customer Support & Sales) preliminary exam. Shortlisted candidates can check their status and download the mains admit card from the SBI careers page; the admit card shows the mains date and centre.

items.short: TGPSC DEO & Gazetted HM Grade-I: key out; objections till 21 Nov
items.text: TGPSC has posted the preliminary key for the Deputy Educational Officer / Gazetted Headmaster Grade-I exams held on 12 and 13 November (Notification 03/G/SE/2026). Objections to the key can be raised online from 18 to 21 November.

items.short: KEA FDA/SDA 2026 (5,431 posts): apply online by 25 Nov
items.text: The Karnataka Examinations Authority's online applications for FDA, SDA and other posts (5,431 vacancies across the RPC and Kalyana Karnataka cadres) close on 25 November; the fee can be paid till 26 November. The written exams are scheduled for 8, 9, 10, 16 and 17 January 2027.

items.short: UPSC CSE 2026 interviews from 7 Dec to 12 Feb; schedule out for 2,526
items.text: UPSC has published the personality test schedule for the 2,526 candidates who cleared the Civil Services (Main) Examination 2026. Interviews run from 7 December 2026 to 12 February 2027 at Dholpur House, New Delhi, and the DAF-II must still be filled by 25 November.

items.short: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-II: final answer keys and marks released
items.text: SSC has put up the final answer keys, response sheets and marks for the CHSL 2025 Tier-II exam. Candidates can see them by logging in on ssc.gov.in for a limited period.

items.short: KEA KREIS teachers: hall tickets out; RPC exams on 22–30 Nov
items.text: KEA has released hall tickets for the RPC-cadre teacher recruitment exams of the Karnataka Residential Educational Institutions Society (KREIS). The papers are held on 22, 27, 29 and 30 November.

items.short: TGPSC AEE (Electrical), R&B Department: CBT on 13 December 2026
items.text: TGPSC has scheduled the computer-based test for Assistant Executive Engineer (Electrical) in the Transport, Roads and Buildings Department (Notification No. 02/G/RB/2026) on 13 December 2026, with forenoon and afternoon sessions. The web note with the schedule is on the TGPSC website.

items.short: APPSC: only one OTPR ID per candidate; multiple IDs strictly prohibited
items.text: APPSC has issued an important notice that a candidate must not hold more than one One Time Profile Registration (OTPR) ID.

items.short: APPSC Thanedar (Forest): walking test call letters out
items.text: APPSC has released the call letter (memo), the physical fitness certificate and a web note for the walking test for Thanedar in the A.P. Forest Subordinate Service (Notification No. 13/2025).

items.short: TGPSC Assistant Scientist (TGPCB): provisional selection for 1 HH vacancy out
items.text: TGPSC has released the provisional selection notification and the selected candidate's marks for the one hearing-impaired (HH) vacancy of Assistant Scientist (Analyst Grade-II) in the Telangana Pollution Control Board (Notification No. 01/OG/PC/2026).

items.short: TGPSC Assistant Environmental Engineer (TGPCB): medical board on 18 and 19 Nov
items.text: For Assistant Environmental Engineer posts in the Telangana Pollution Control Board (Notification No. 02/OG/PC/2026), TGPSC has called visually impaired (VH) candidates to the medical board on 18 November and hearing-impaired (HH) candidates on 19 November. Details are in the web note on the TGPSC website.

items.short: OPSC: admit cards out for Asst Public Prosecutor and Veterinary Surgeon exams
items.text: OPSC has opened the download of admission certificates for the written exams for Assistant Public Prosecutor (Advt. 09 of 2026-27) and Veterinary Assistant Surgeon (Advt. 04 of 2026-27). It has also published the preliminary exam programme for Assistant Executive Engineer (Civil), Advt. 07 of 2026-27.

items.short: SSC CPO 2026 Paper-I on 23-28 Nov; exam city status is live
items.text: SSC CPO (SI in Delhi Police and CAPFs) 2026 Paper-I runs from 23 to 28 November. The exam city and admit card status is live on ssc.gov.in; candidates flagged for Class 10 detail mismatches must upload their Class 10 marksheet by 20 November. Admit cards come 2-3 days before each shift.

items.short: APPSC: edit option opened for 2026 applications (Group-I, Forest posts, EO and more)
items.text: APPSC has opened application correction for its 2026 notifications, including Group-I (No. 07/2026), Forest Range Officer, Forest Section Officer and Forest Beat Officer, Executive Officer Grade-III, Industrial Promotion Officer, Analyst Grade-II and others. It also published a corrigendum for FRO, FSO, FBO and Group-II.

items.short: MPSC Group-C 2026: posts raised to 16,717; apply till 27 Nov, prelims 24 Jan 2027
items.text: MPSC has added new cadres to the Group-C Services Combined Preliminary Examination 2026, taking the vacancies to 16,717. The online window has reopened for new applicants and for cadre preferences until 27 November, and the prelims has moved from 3 January to 24 January 2027.

items.short: SSC GD Constable 2026: PET/PST admit cards out
items.text: SSC has released the physical test (PET/PST) admit cards for candidates who qualified in the GD Constable written exam (Constable GD in CAPFs and SSF, Rifleman GD in Assam Rifles). Check your physical test date on the admit card.

items.short: UPSC CSE 2026 Mains qualifiers: fill the DAF-II by 25 Nov (6 PM)
items.text: Candidates who cleared the Civil Services (Main) Examination 2026 must complete the Detailed Application Form-II on the UPSC online portal; the window runs from 11 November to 25 November, 6 PM. It must be submitted even if no details have changed.

items.short: APPSC Group-II 2026: detailed notification out, apply online now
items.text: APPSC has published the detailed notification for Group-II Services (Notification No. 37/2026) and opened online applications. Reports put the screening test on 21 February 2027; check the notification for the posts and the last date.

items.short: IBPS RRB PO (Officer Scale-I) prelims call letters out; exam 21-22 Nov
items.text: IBPS has released the call letters for the RRB Officer Scale-I (PO) preliminary exam, to be held on 21 and 22 November 2026, on ibps.in.

items.short: TNPSC Group 4 2026: edit window 9–11 Nov; written exam on 10 Jan 2027
items.text: TNPSC opened the correction window for Group 4 (Combined Civil Services Examination-IV) applications from 9 to 11 November. The written exam is scheduled for 10 January 2027, 9:30 am to 12:30 pm, and hall tickets are due about 10–14 days before it.

items.short: SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I: tentative answer key and response sheets out
items.text: SSC published the tentative answer key and candidates' response sheets for the CGL 2026 Tier-I computer-based exam held from 30 September, with a short window to challenge answers. The Tier-I result is awaited.

items.short: RRB NTPC (UG) typing skill test on 27 Nov for typist posts
items.text: The RRBs have scheduled the computer-based typing skill test for candidates shortlisted for Accounts Clerk cum Typist and Junior Clerk cum Typist (CEN 07/2025) on 27 November (tentative). The exam city slip comes about 10 days earlier and the e-call letter about 4 days before the test.
